contract.ambiguity: Refuse when full image matches more than one distinct source SHA-256; optimization profiles of the same source are grouped.
contract.cross_version: Refuse; no fuzzy, register-normalized or opcode-multiset lookup.
contract.metadata_scope: Function names, type payloads, native flags and string pool remain exact. Debug line/local tables may differ and are reported. Debug line/stack reflection is outside source compatibility. Explicit opaque container trailers are not authenticated.

limitations: Matched source is compatible with the exact retained v9 execution image under the recorded compiler profile. Original source text, debug line/stack reflection, opaque transport authentication and module availability at runtime are not established. Unmatched code is not automatically classified as custom. Ordinary decompilation is unchanged.
